title: Guest Experience 360
thesis: Snowflake unifies guest data across 120 properties, analyzes sentiment from 200K reviews, generates personalized recommendations, and delivers targeted communications — all native SQL, replacing fragmented guest CRM

talking_points: Portfolio guest sentiment at 0.72 — down from 0.78 last quarter.
Seven properties showing declining NPS trends. Phuket Beachfront dropped 12 points.
Three hundred forty-two guests in service recovery queue (negative review, no follow-up).
tabs.call_out: Sentiment declining — 342 unhappy guests awaiting recovery

transition.line: Let's drill into what guests are saying.

talking_points: AI_SENTIMENT analyzes 200K reviews in Thai, English, Chinese, and Korean.
Top complaints: pool maintenance (Phuket), check-in speed (Bangkok), food quality (Samui).
AI_EXTRACT identifies specific pain points: 'waited 25 minutes at reception' patterns.
show: Show sentiment heatmap by property and topic
Click a topic to see review examples
tabs.call_out: 200K reviews analyzed — actionable insights by property and topic

transition.line: How do we turn insight into personalized action?

talking_points: Cortex Complete generates personalized recommendations for 25,000 upcoming stays.
Guest G-28471 (Chinese, Platinum, 7 stays): recommend spa upgrade + late checkout based on history.
Service recovery: AI drafts personalized apology with compensation offer for negative reviewers.
tabs.call_out: AI-personalized experiences for 180K guests — from review to recovery

transition.line: Now let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Natthawut asks: 'Which properties have the most negative Chinese guest reviews?'
Cortex Analyst: Phuket Beachfront (34 negative), Bangkok Riverside (28), Samui Villas (22).
Switch to advisor: 'How should we improve Chinese guest experience?' — generates strategy with specific actions.
show: Type: 'Properties with most negative Chinese reviews'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + guest strategy advisory

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Thailand's 28M annual tourists generate billions in reviews. This personalizes for 180K guests.
tabs.call_out: From review to recovery action — one automated pipeline
